content: This document provides a detailed list of countries and territories ranked by their population. The rankings include both sovereign states and self-governing dependent territories. Population figures are derived from the most recent estimates or projections provided by national census authorities, where available, and are generally rounded for simplicity. In cases where national data is unavailable, figures are based on the United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs – Population Division's mid-year estimate for 2007. It is important to note that population data is not collected simultaneously across all countries, nor is it gathered with uniform accuracy. As a result, the rankings presented may not always be entirely reliable or directly comparable. For the sake of comprehensive comparison, some non-sovereign entities are included in the list, although only sovereign territories are formally ranked. Specific notes include the following: Mainland China is considered separately from other territories. Population data for regions such as Jammu and Kashmir (administered by India), Azad Kashmir (administered by Pakistan), and Aksai Chin (administered by the People's Republic of China) are included. The figures for Taiwan encompass the island groups of Taiwan, the Pescadores, Kinmen, Matsu, and others. The population of Christmas Island (1,508), the Cocos (Keeling) Islands (628), and Norfolk Island (1,828) is included in the relevant totals. Kosovo is included in the population data. The United Nations mid-2007 estimate of 6,967,000 excludes the Israeli population residing in the West Bank. The population of the Åland Islands is included. Svalbard (2,701) and Jan Mayen Island are included in the data. The Republic of Abkhazia (216,000) and South Ossetia (70,000) are included in the figures. Transnistria's population (555,347) is included. The territories of Agalega, Rodrigues, and St. Brandon are included in the population data. The Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus (264,172) is included, while the Statistical Institute of the Republic of Cyprus reports a population of 749,200 based on the 2004 census. Mayotte, an island, is excluded from the population figures for France.
